lines.text: Many learners say: I go to school by foot.
Better: I go to school on foot.
On! She goes to work on foot.

data.wrong: I go to school by foot.
data.right: I go to school on foot.

native.tip: Пешком — “on foot”: “I go to school on foot.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I go to school by foot”? 😅 По-русски «пешком» — одно слово, поэтому по аналогии с “by bus” и “by car” хочется сказать “by foot”, но верно “on foot.” Правильно: “I go to school on foot.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “on.” Пешком — on foot. Скажи вслух: “I go to … on foot.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: To walk somewhere, use “on foot”: “I go to school on foot.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I go to school by foot”? 😅 In Russian it is one word, so “by bus” and “by car” pull you to “by foot”, but the right phrase is “on foot.” Correct: “I go to school on foot.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
